headline: Simon Property Group Reports Q3 2026 Results and Raises Full-Year Guidance
summary: Simon Property Group reported third-quarter 2026 financial results, increasing its full-year real estate funds from operations (FFO) per share guidance and raising its quarterly dividend.
why: Simon Property Group is a major real estate investment trust (REIT) focused on shopping and mixed-use destinations, serving as a key indicator for the health of the retail real estate sector.

impacts.name: Simon Property Group
impacts.why: Positive earnings and guidance updates typically drive investor sentiment for the company's stock.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The increase in full-year FFO guidance and the dividend hike are positive signals for shareholders, typically leading to upward price pressure on the stock.
